text.name: Heracross

attacks.name: Spike Draw
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: High Horsepower
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

text.flavor: This powerful Pokémon thrusts its prized horn under its enemies’ bellies, then lifts and throws them.

text.name: Surskit

attacks.name: Multiply
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Surskit and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

text.flavor: It secretes a thick, sweet-scented syrup from the tip of its head. It lives on weed-choked ponds.

text.name: Masquerain

attacks.name: Frightening Pattern
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't use attacks.

attacks.name: Bug Out
attacks.text: Reveal the bottom 7 cards of your deck, and this attack does 50 damage for each Pokémon you find there that has the Bug Out attack. Then, shuffle any revealed Pokémon back into your deck. Discard the other cards.

text.flavor: The antennae have distinctive patterns that look like eyes. When it rains, they grow heavy, making flight impossible.

text.name: Cacnea

attacks.name: Knock Away
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

text.flavor: It lives in arid locations. Its yellow flowers bloom once a year.

text.name: Cacturne

attacks.name: Linear Attack
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Punishing Needles
attacks.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each of your opponent's Pokémon in play that has an Ability.

text.flavor: It lives in deserts. It becomes active at night when it hunts for prey exhausted from the desert's heat.

text.name: Combee

attacks.name: Fade Out
attacks.text: Put this Pokémon and all attached cards into your hand.

attacks.name: Bug Out
attacks.text: Reveal the bottom 7 cards of your deck, and this attack does 50 damage for each Pokémon you find there that has the Bug Out attack. Then, shuffle any revealed Pokémon back into your deck. Discard the other cards.

text.flavor: The trio is together from birth. It constantly gathers nectar from flowers to please Vespiquen.

text.name: Vespiquen

attacks.name: Clean Hit
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an Evolution Pokémon, this attack does 80 more damage.

text.flavor: It raises grubs in the holes in its body. It secretes pheromones to control Combee.

text.name: Shaymin

attacks.name: Overrun
attacks.text: This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

text.flavor: It can dissolve toxins in the air to instantly transform ruined land into a lush field of flowers.

text.name: Virizion

attacks.name: Double Draw
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

text.flavor: It confounds opponents with its quick movement, darting around them like a whirlwind as it carves them up mercilessly with its sharp horns.

text.name: Wimpod

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Punk Out
abilities.text: If your opponent has any Pokémon ex in play, this Pokémon has no Retreat Cost.

text.flavor: Its habitat includes everything from beaches to seabeds. It is happy to eat up even rotten scraps, providing a sort of natural cleaning service.

attacks.name: Finishing Blow
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 160 more damage.

attacks.name: Quadruple Hold
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

rules.label: Mega Evolution ex rule
rules.text: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

text.name: Sprigatito

attacks.name: Play Rough
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

text.flavor: The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.

text.name: Floragato
text.flavor: The hardness of Floragato's fur depends on the Pokémon's mood. When Floragato is prepared to battle, its fur becomes pointed and needle sharp.

attacks.name: Magical Bullet
attacks.text: This attack also does 120 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

rules.label: Pokémon ex rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Smoliv
text.flavor: This Pokémon converts nutrients into oil, which it stores in the fruit on its head. It can easily go a whole week without eating or drinking.

text.name: Dolliv
text.flavor: It basks in the sun to its heart's content until the fruits on its head ripen. After that, Dolliv departs from human settlements and goes on a journey.

text.name: Arboliva

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Slippery Oil
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Mega Drain
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

text.flavor: This Pokémon drives back enemies by launching its rich, aromatic oil at them with enough force to smash a boulder.

text.name: Growlithe

attacks.name: Roar
attacks.text: Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

text.flavor: It's very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.

text.name: Arcanine

attacks.name: Fervent Fang
attacks.text: If your opponent has 4 or fewer Prize cards remaining, this attack does 90 more damage.

attacks.name: Heat Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 50 damage to itself.

text.flavor: Its magnificent bark conveys a sense of majesty. Anyone hearing it can't help but grovel before it.

text.name: Magmar

attacks.name: Gather Strength
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

text.flavor: Wavering flames similar to those of the sun appear on the surface of this Pokémon's body.

text.name: Magmortar

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Buddy Boost
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Attach a Basic {Fire} Energy card, a Basic {Lightning} Energy card, or 1 of each from your hand to your Electivire and Magmortar in any way you like.

text.flavor: They dwell in volcanic craters. It's said that only a single pair of Magmortar will inhabit any given volcano.

text.name: Torkoal

attacks.name: Searing Flame
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Combustion Blast
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Combustion Blast.

text.flavor: Coal is the source of Torkoal's energy. Large amounts of coal can be found in the mountains where they live.

attacks.name: Rewarm
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each Basic {Fire} Energy card in your discard pile. Then, shuffle those cards into your deck.

attacks.name: Strong Flare
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

rules.label: Pokémon ex rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Heatmor

attacks.name: Destructive Flame
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

text.flavor: There's a hole in its tail that allows it to draw in the air it needs to keep its fire burning. If the hole gets blocked, this Pokémon will fall ill.

text.name: Mantine

attacks.name: Make Waves
attacks.text: Each player shuffles their hand into their deck and draws 4 cards.

attacks.name: Bubble Drain
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

text.flavor: If it builds up enough speed swimming, it can jump out above the waves and glide for over 300 feet.

text.name: Kyogre

attacks.name: Brutal Whirlpool
attacks.text: If a Stadium that has "Legendary" in its name is in play, this attack also does 50 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

text.flavor: In myths, this Pokémon expanded the seas with torrential rains and great tsunamis. It battled ferociously against Groudon.

text.name: Frillish
text.flavor: It envelops its prey in its veillike arms and draws it down to the deeps, five miles below the ocean's surface.

text.name: Jellicent

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Deep Sea Draw
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Draw a card. If you do, you may put a card from your hand on the bottom of your deck.

text.flavor: Most of this Pokémon's body composition is identical to sea water. It makes sunken ships its lair.

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Oceanic Gain
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may use this Ability. Heal 50 damage from this Pokémon.

rules.label: Pokémon ex rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Electabuzz

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

text.flavor: Research is progressing on storing lightning in Electabuzz so this energy can be used at any time.

text.name: Electivire

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Voltaic Hammer
attacks.text: Discard any amount of Basic Energy from this Pokémon, and this attack does 60 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

text.flavor: This Pokémon presses the tips of its tails onto an opponent and instantly sends over 20,000 volts of high-voltage electricity through them.

text.name: Jolteon

attacks.name: Thunderbolt
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

text.flavor: It absorbs negative ions from the atmosphere to spit out 10,000 volts of electricity.

attacks.name: Thunder-Clad
attacks.text: If you go first, you can use this attack during your first turn. Search your deck for an Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Power Rush
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, during your next turn, this Pokémon can't use attacks.

rules.label: Pokémon ex rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Rotom

attacks.name: Thunder Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

text.flavor: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

text.name: Thundurus

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Incarnate Solidarity
abilities.text: If you have Tornadus, Thundurus, Landorus, and Enamorus in play, ignore all {Colorless} Energy in the costs of attacks used by this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Thunderous Edge
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

text.flavor: As it flies around, it shoots lightning all over the place and causes forest fires. It is therefore disliked.

text.name: Pincurchin

attacks.name: Energy Crush
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each Energy attached to all of your opponent's Pokémon.

text.flavor: This Pokémon is so timid that even brushing against seaweed will make it discharge electricity in surprise. Its lips do not conduct electricity.

text.name: Pawmi

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

text.flavor: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

text.name: Pawmo
text.flavor: Pawmo uses a unique fighting technique in which it uses its forepaws to strike foes and zap them with electricity from its paw pads simultaneously.

text.name: Pawmot

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Generator's Touch
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Attach a Basic {Lightning} Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Pokémon.

text.flavor: Pawmot's fluffy fur acts as a battery. It can store the same amount of electricity as an electric car.

text.name: Wattrel

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

text.flavor: These Pokémon make their nests on coastal cliffs. The nests have a strange, crackling texture, and they're a popular delicacy.

text.name: Kilowattrel

attacks.name: Raid
attacks.text: If this Pokémon evolved from Wattrel during this turn, this attack does 90 more damage.

text.flavor: It uses its throat sac to store electricity generated by its wings. There's hardly any oil in its feathers, so it is a poor swimmer.

text.name: Miraidon

attacks.name: Flashing Bolt
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Flashing Bolt.

text.flavor: This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in an old book. The Iron Serpent is said to have turned the land to ash with its lightning.

text.name: Drowzee
text.flavor: When it twitches its nose, it can tell where someone is sleeping and what that person is dreaming about.

text.name: Hypno

attacks.name: Mind Ruler
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each card in your opponent's hand.

attacks.name: Hypnoblast
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

text.flavor: Always holding a pendulum that it swings at a steady rhythm, it causes drowsiness in anyone nearby.

text.name: Giratina

attacks.name: Chaos Crawler
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from attacks done to this Pokémon. If 1 of your Pokémon used Chaos Crawler during your last turn, this attack can't be used.

text.flavor: This Pokémon is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours, where common knowledge is distorted and strange.

text.name: Golett
text.flavor: Ancient people apparently fashioned Golett out of clay to do their labor for them. What powers these Pokémon remains unclear.

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Restricted Activation
abilities.text: This Pokémon can't use attacks unless you have 10 or more cards in your hand.

attacks.name: Goliath's Punch
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

rules.label: Mega Evolution ex rule
rules.text: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

text.name: Enamorus

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Incarnate Solidarity
abilities.text: If you have Tornadus, Thundurus, Landorus, and Enamorus in play, ignore all {Colorless} Energy in the costs of attacks used by this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Rising Heart
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex, this attack does 100 more damage.

text.flavor: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.

text.name: Sandshrew

attacks.name: Ascension
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

text.flavor: No matter how high a place it falls from, this Pokémon can save itself by rolling into a ball and bouncing.

text.name: Sandslash

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Counterattack Quills
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), place 3 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

attacks.name: Digging Claw
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

text.flavor: The spikes on its body are made up of its hardened hide. It rolls up and attacks foes with its spikes.

text.name: Onix

attacks.name: Guard Press
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

text.flavor: It usually lives underground. It searches for food while boring its way through the ground at 50 mph.

text.name: Steelix

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: High Density Armor
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has full HP, it takes 60 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Tough Swing
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

text.flavor: It chews its way through boulders with its sturdy jaws. Its eyes can see in the darkness underground.

text.name: Groudon

attacks.name: Brutal Lands
attacks.text: If a Stadium that has "Legendary" in its name is in play, this attack does 170 more damage.

text.flavor: Groudon is said to have expanded the reach of dry land by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled ferociously against Kyogre.

text.name: Landorus

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Incarnate Solidarity
abilities.text: If you have Tornadus, Thundurus, Landorus, and Enamorus in play, ignore all {Colorless} Energy in the costs of attacks used by this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Gaia Crush
attacks.text: Discard a Stadium in play.

text.flavor: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as "The Guardian of the Fields."

text.name: Nidoran♀

attacks.name: Find a Friend
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

text.flavor: Females are more sensitive to smells than males. While foraging, they'll use their whiskers to check wind direction and stay downwind of predators.

text.name: Nidorina
text.flavor: The horn on its head has atrophied. It's thought that this happens so Nidorina's children won't get poked while their mother is feeding them.

text.name: Nidoqueen

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Maternal Call
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Flip a coin. If heads, switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.

attacks.name: Giga Impact
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use attacks.

text.flavor: Nidoqueen is better at defense than offense. With scales like armor, this Pokémon will shield its children from any kind of attack.

text.name: Spinarak

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Bug Out
attacks.text: Reveal the bottom 7 cards of your deck, and this attack does 50 damage for each Pokémon you find there that has the Bug Out attack. Then, shuffle any revealed Pokémon back into your deck. Discard the other cards.

text.flavor: It spins a web using fine yet durable thread. It then waits patiently for prey to be trapped.

text.name: Ariados

attacks.name: Tormenting Poison
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. During Pokémon Checkup, place 4 damage counters on that Pokémon instead of 1.

attacks.name: Stealthy Sting
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Basic Pokémon.

text.flavor: It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It's hard to tell which end is which.

text.name: Sableye

attacks.name: Lure Out
attacks.text: Reveal the top 5 cards of your opponent's deck. You may choose any number of Basic Pokémon you find there and put those Pokémon onto their Bench. Your opponent shuffles the other cards back into their deck.

attacks.name: Ominous Eyes
attacks.text: Place 5 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

text.flavor: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.

text.name: Carvanha

attacks.name: Ambush
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

text.flavor: They live in massive rivers that course through jungles. Swarms of these Pokémon attack any prey that wanders into their territory.

text.name: Sharpedo

attacks.name: Crunch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

text.flavor: It can swim at speeds of 75 mph by jetting seawater through its body. It is the bandit of the sea.

text.name: Darkrai

attacks.name: Shadow-Clad
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic {Darkness} Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

text.flavor: It can lull people into a deep sleep and make them dream. It is active on nights with a new moon.

text.name: Purrloin
text.flavor: Purrloin steals from people for fun, but its behavior is so charming that its victims can't help but forgive it.

text.name: Liepard

attacks.name: Follow-Up Claw
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

text.flavor: Liepard appear without warning and disappear just as unexpectedly. Their beautiful physique and fur charm many Trainers.

text.name: Zorua
text.flavor: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

attacks.name: Riotous Beating
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each of your Pokémon in play.

attacks.name: Slashing Strike
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Slashing Strike.

rules.label: Pokémon ex rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Inkay

attacks.name: Knock Off
attacks.text: Discard a random card from your opponent's hand.

text.flavor: It drains foes' will to fight by flashing light at them. It then takes the opportunity to hide itself away.

attacks.name: Psychic Marionette
attacks.text: This attack does 70 damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Eerie Wave
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

rules.label: Mega Evolution ex rule
rules.text: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

text.name: Morpeko

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

text.flavor: Intense hunger drives it to extremes of violence, and the electricity in its cheek sacs has converted into a Dark-type energy.

text.name: Zarude

attacks.name: Deadly Whip
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, this attack does 150 more damage.

text.flavor: Within dense forests, this Pokémon lives in a pack with others of its kind. It's incredibly aggressive, and the other Pokémon of the forest fear it.

text.name: Druddigon

attacks.name: Drag Off
attacks.text: Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot. This attack does 40 damage to the new Active Pokémon.

text.flavor: Druddigon lives in caves, but it never skips sunbathing—it won't be able to move if its body gets too cold.

text.name: Jangmo-o

attacks.name: Hard Head
attacks.text: During your opponent’s next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

text.flavor: They communicate with their allies using the sounds their scales make when struck. A group of these Pokémon causes quite a racket.

text.name: Hakamo-o

attacks.name: Double Smash
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 70 damage for each heads.

text.flavor: It fires itself up by striking its scales with force as it dances. Its roar is a battle cry.

text.name: Kommo-o

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Beat Scales
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Look at the top 6 cards of your deck and attach any number of Basic Energy cards you find there to your {Dragon} Pokémon in any way you like. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

text.flavor: It bashes its scales to test its opponents' mettle. The sound of struck Kommo-o scales frightens weaker foes and sends them running.

text.name: Cyclizar

attacks.name: Break Through
attacks.text: This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

text.flavor: Cyclizar keeps energy stored in the folds of its throat, allowing it to run nonstop over very long distances while carrying someone.

text.name: Tauros

attacks.name: Raging Horns
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

text.flavor: They fight each other by locking horns. The herd's protectors take pride in their battle-scarred horns.

text.name: Eevee

attacks.name: Nap
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

text.flavor: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

text.name: Delibird

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Energizing Present
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may use this Ability. Look at the top 6 cards of your deck, reveal an Energy card you find there, and put it into your hand. Shuffle the other cards and put them on the bottom of your deck.

text.flavor: It carries food rolled up in its tail. It has a habit of sharing food with people lost in the mountains.

text.name: Azurill

attacks.name: Bouncy-Bounce Charge
attacks.text: Search your deck for an Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

text.flavor: Its tail is packed full of the nutrients it needs to grow.

text.name: Swablu

attacks.name: Run Around
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

text.flavor: For some reason, it likes to land on people's heads softly and act like it's a hat.

text.name: Altaria

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Cottony Carrier
abilities.text: Your Basic Pokémon in play have no Retreat Cost.

text.flavor: It flies gracefully through the sky. Its melodic humming makes you feel like you're in a dream.

text.name: Kecleon

attacks.name: Colorful Whip
attacks.text: Reveal any number of Pokémon from your hand, and this attack does 30 damage for each different type of Pokémon you revealed in this way.

text.flavor: It changes color to blend in with its surroundings in order to sneak up on prey. It can't make its belly pattern disappear, however.

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Ruler's Roar
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench, you may use this Ability. Look at the top 4 cards of your deck and attach a Basic Energy card you find there to this Pokémon. Shuffle the other cards and put them on the bottom of your deck.

attacks.name: Storm Emerald
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage for each {Fire} Energy and each {Lightning} Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.

rules.label: Mega Evolution ex rule
rules.text: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

text.name: Tornadus

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Incarnate Solidarity
abilities.text: If you have Tornadus, Thundurus, Landorus, and Enamorus in play, ignore all {Colorless} Energy in the costs of attacks used by this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Corkscrew Dive
attacks.text: You may draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.

text.flavor: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

text.name: Fletchling

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

text.flavor: Despite the beauty of its lilting voice, it's merciless to intruders that enter its territory.

text.name: Fletchinder

attacks.name: Clutch
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

text.flavor: The hotter the flame sac in its belly, the faster it can fly, but it takes some time to get the fire going.

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Excited Dive
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in your hand, and if you have any {Colorless} Mega Evolution Pokémon ex in play, you may use this Ability. Put this Pokémon onto your Bench.

attacks.name: Talon Hunt
attacks.text: You may search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

rules.label: Pokémon ex rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Aarune
effect: Search your deck for up to 3 in any combination of Supporter and Stadium cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

text.name: Adventure Lantern
effect: Search your deck for a Basic {Fire} Energy card and a Basic {Lightning} Energy card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Custom Vest
effect: If the Pokémon this card is attached to isn't a Mega Evolution Pokémon ex, it takes 60 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Mega Evolution Pokémon ex (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

rules.text: You may attach any number of Pokémon Tools to your Pokémon during your turn. You may attach only 1 Pokémon Tool to each Pokémon, and it stays attached.

text.name: Emcee's Hype
effect: Draw 2 cards. If your opponent has 3 or fewer Prize cards remaining, draw 2 more cards.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

text.name: Grisham
effect: Heal 50 damage from each Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's).

text.name: Masquerain

attacks.name: Frightening Pattern
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't use attacks.

attacks.name: Bug Out
attacks.text: Reveal the bottom 7 cards of your deck, and this attack does 50 damage for each Pokémon you find there that has the Bug Out attack. Then, shuffle any revealed Pokémon back into your deck. Discard the other cards.

text.flavor: The antennae have distinctive patterns that look like eyes. When it rains, they grow heavy, making flight impossible.

text.name: Sprigatito

attacks.name: Play Rough
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

text.flavor: The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.

text.name: Growlithe

attacks.name: Roar
attacks.text: Switch out your opponent's Active Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)

text.flavor: It's very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.

text.name: Magmortar

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Buddy Boost
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Attach a Basic {Fire} Energy card, a Basic {Lightning} Energy card, or 1 of each from your hand to your Electivire and Magmortar in any way you like.

text.flavor: They dwell in volcanic craters. It's said that only a single pair of Magmortar will inhabit any given volcano.

text.name: Electivire

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Voltaic Hammer
attacks.text: Discard any amount of Basic Energy from this Pokémon, and this attack does 60 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

text.flavor: This Pokémon presses the tips of its tails onto an opponent and instantly sends over 20,000 volts of high-voltage electricity through them.

text.name: Pincurchin

attacks.name: Energy Crush
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each Energy attached to all of your opponent's Pokémon.

text.flavor: This Pokémon is so timid that even brushing against seaweed will make it discharge electricity in surprise. Its lips do not conduct electricity.

text.name: Enamorus

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Incarnate Solidarity
abilities.text: If you have Tornadus, Thundurus, Landorus, and Enamorus in play, ignore all {Colorless} Energy in the costs of attacks used by this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Rising Heart
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex, this attack does 100 more damage.

text.flavor: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.

text.name: Groudon

attacks.name: Brutal Lands
attacks.text: If a Stadium that has “Legendary” in its name is in play, this attack does 170 more damage.

text.flavor: Groudon is said to have expanded the reach of dry land by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled ferociously against Kyogre.

text.name: Zorua
text.flavor: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

text.name: Inkay

attacks.name: Knock Off
attacks.text: Discard a random card from your opponent's hand.

text.flavor: It drains foes' will to fight by flashing light at them. It then takes the opportunity to hide itself away.

text.name: Eevee

attacks.name: Nap
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

text.flavor: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

text.name: Azurill

attacks.name: Bouncy-Bounce Charge
attacks.text: Search your deck for an Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

text.flavor: Its tail is packed full of the nutrients it needs to grow.

text.name: Altaria

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Cottony Carrier
abilities.text: Your Basic Pokémon in play have no Retreat Cost.

text.flavor: It flies gracefully through the sky. Its melodic humming makes you feel like you're in a dream.

text.name: Kecleon

attacks.name: Colorful Whip
attacks.text: Reveal any number of Pokémon from your hand, and this attack does 30 damage for each different type of Pokémon you revealed in this way.

text.flavor: It changes color to blend in with its surroundings in order to sneak up on prey. It can't make its belly pattern disappear, however.
